description: This file contains Perl code implementing AES encryption/decryption routines, key schedule, and related cryptographic functions for x86_64/SSSE3, including assembly code snippets and external references to other modules.

methods.name: _aes_encrypt_core
methods.description: Perl assembly routine for AES encryption core using SSSE3 instructions.

methods.name: _aes_encrypt_core_2x
methods.description: Parallel AES encryption core for two blocks.

methods.name: _aes_decrypt_core_2x
methods.description: Parallel AES decryption core for two blocks.

methods.name: _aes_schedule_core
methods.description: AES key schedule core for generating round keys.

methods.name: _aes_schedule_round
methods.description: Performs one round of key schedule transformation.

methods.name: _aes_schedule_transform
methods.description: Linear transformation of key schedule data.

methods.name: _aes_schedule_mangle
methods.description: Mangles key schedule data for final round.

methods.name: vpaes_ctr32_encrypt_blocks
